top_signals.title: Guyana Oil Exports to Top 1 Million Barrels a Day for First Time
top_signals.summary: Guyana’s crude oil exports are set to surpass 1 million barrels a day for the first time when the country starts shipping its Uaru grade in December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Big Banks Deliver Mixed Results to Kick Off Earnings on Wall Street
top_signals.summary: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
